description:
Every version of a post, oldest first, ending with the current one.

    An edit that changes a post's title or body keeps the version it
    replaced, and anyone who can read the post can read them. Each version
    has its ``title`` and ``body``, when it was the one shown
    (``current_from`` / ``current_until``, null for the current version)
    and whose edit replaced it (``replaced_by``: ``author`` or ``admin``).
    A version a site admin hid is left out and counted in ``hidden_count``.
    A post's ``edited_at`` and ``revision_count`` say whether there is
    anything here before you ask. Same answer as
    ``GET /api/v1/posts/{post_id}/history``. No auth required.

post_id.description: UUID of the post whose versions to fetch
post_id.title: Post Id

name: colony_get_post_history
